name: ncm-k8s-collector-operator
description: Unified Multi-Cluster Telemetry Operator. Reconciles telemetry.platform/v1 TelemetryIntent custom resources into merged OpenTelemetry Collector configs and deploys a single set of collectors per managed k8s cluster.
overview:
## Overview
Unified Multi-Cluster Telemetry Operator is a single collector operator that
lets multiple clients declare the telemetry they want via a
`telemetryintents.telemetry.nutanix.com` `TelemetryIntent` CR. It:

- Merges every intent in a workspace into two OpenTelemetry Collector configs
  per cluster (a per-node DaemonSet config and a cluster-singleton Deployment
  config) using an embedded, version-pinned catalog.
- Deploys one collector App per workspace on the management cluster and every
  attached workload cluster, plus any cluster attached in the future, with no
  human action.

Deleting every intent triggers a clean tear-down of the collectors across all
clusters, driven by a finalizer on each `TelemetryIntent`.
